purpose: Narrowest RPL pilot able to fit a fixed, simple Poisson baseline, evaluate on an untouched completed season, and display current fixtures without assuming future data.
evidenceFileScope: 2026-10-20 pinned aggregated publisher counts; not independent match correctness or licensing proof
rules: Every included season requires explicit lawful acquisition, retention, backups, ML training and derived forecast display rights, including upstream data provenance; a publisher CC BY/CC0 label alone does not attest its upstream rights.
Verify full 240 unique directed fixtures and corrected official home/away and result/status using independently lawful primary records; quarantine contradictions and awarded games.
Current-season fixtures must be authorized, refreshed at no cost, and checked for cancellations, corrections and actual kickoff timezones; a static snapshot never proves current freshness.
For the minimal completed-season evaluation, fit a pre-registered simple baseline on 2024/25 and score 2025/26 without using its outcomes for hyperparameters, calibration or feature selection.

Retrospective reconstructed predictions must be labeled non-strict unless pre-match published-and-observed source snapshots are authenticated; current records downloaded later are not historical as-of evidence.

After one sealed evaluation, live use may refit on both completed seasons and strictly pre-cutoff current results, with an immutable forecast ledger; retroactive backtest improvement or full calibration is not established.

No separate independent validation/calibration cohort exists at this minimum. M3 reliability/calibration claims require more authorized historical data or pre-registered prospective observations; do not tune on the holdout.
Do not import, train, activate providers, publish real forecasts or claim M1 approved on this policy change alone.
